title: Love Means Caring: Adriana's turning point and the plot's new conflicts
seoTitle: Love Means Caring: Adriana's Turn and New Conflicts
subtitle: Discover how the discovery of the inheritance changes the protagonist's path and intensifies disputes
excerpt: Adriana receives a secret fortune left by Arthur, sells jewels to a sheikh, and gains Pedro's support, while new tensions arise among Pilar, Ingrid, and Iuri.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last week, the revelation of a secret fortune left by Arthur drove the protagonist Adriana to drastically change her standing in the soap opera Quem Ama Cuida, sparking new alliances and clashes among the characters.

Adriana discovers the inheritance and changes her life

Six years after her wrongful conviction, Adriana (Letícia Colin) finds an object with an engraved name and a sequence of numbers that lead her to a safe containing jewels, necklaces, rings, luxury pieces, and gold bars registered in her name. With Iuri's support, she converts part of the assets into cash by selling the jewels to a sheikh, thereby receiving an amount far superior to what she had before.

Conflicts between main characters

Pedro (Chay Suede) decides to wait for Adriana at her house to find out the reason for her lie, while being surprised by Pilar's visit. In another storyline, Pilar catches Ingrid in Iuri's room, orders Iuri to stay away from Ingrid, and later demands that he put on a private fashion show for her. Dora and André kiss, and Dora seeks out Pedro to affirm her belief in Adriana's innocence, promising to listen to his plea for forgiveness.

Revenge plans and jewelry business

Adriana reveals to her family and to Pedro her plan for revenge against the Brandão family, using her newly acquired financial backing. She also plans to use part of the resources on a personal project related to the jewelry sector, a field she knows well from the time she worked for Arthur. The purchase of a high-end apartment, which is expected to surprise her brother Maurício, is scheduled for the August 27 episode.

Twists in family relationships

Pilar accepts Brigitte's return home at the request of Ingrid and Rafael, but under conditions. She also shows interest in Tom during his work at her house. Meanwhile, Nicolau apologizes to Lyris, and Iuri mentions to Lyris his fear of losing his job. Carmita criticizes Bruna for still not having signed the divorce papers, and Suely is surprised when approached by Ademir asking for forgiveness and proposing a reconciliation.

Next steps of the plot

In the upcoming episodes, Adriana and Pedro believe they will find evidence to clear the physical therapist's name, while Pedro warns Dora about Ademir, who may use his knowledge to prolong the contested divorce. Diná visits Francesca's tomb and apologizes, being watched by Otoniel. The plot moves forward by linking the financial inheritance to the unfolding investigation into the fraud that convicted Adriana, putting her in a position to confront those responsible with real resources.

With information from Gshow, Notícias da TV, Terra.
